cooked: The mempool can’t provide advance data availability for this transaction: nodes reject spends of immature coinbase outputs, so the fanout can’t sit there during the 100-block maturity period. It can be broadcast once spendable, but users still need another way to obtain the transaction data beforehand, such as pool-operated publication or an external relay. That seems to make data availability a bigger drawback than the post suggests.
